data.question: Which Ahmedabad colleges do you help with?
data.answer: I regularly help students from GTU-affiliated colleges, LJ University, Silver Oak University, Nirma University, GLS University, Indus University, and other Ahmedabad-area colleges.

data.question: Can you help if my project submission is next week?
data.answer: Yes. Urgent timelines are possible. Share your requirements on WhatsApp and we'll discuss what's achievable within your deadline.

data.question: Do I need to know programming to work with you?
data.answer: No prior coding knowledge is required. You'll receive a working project with enough explanation to confidently present it during your viva.

data.question: Can you help with documentation and project reports?
data.answer: Yes. Assistance with project documentation, synopsis, and reports is available as part of the service.
